steps.narrate: The dashboard provides a comprehensive overview of key metrics and recent activity.
At the top of the page, we see the main navigation and user profile.
Let's explore the key metrics section.
Total Users shows the current user count with a trend indicator.
Revenue displays the current period earnings with a comparison to the previous period.
Conversion Rate tracks the percentage of visitors who complete a desired action.
Moving to the activity feed below the metrics.
The activity feed shows recent events and user actions in real time.
The Refresh button updates all metrics and activity data.
Users can export a detailed report in PDF or CSV format for sharing.
